prompts.title: Meeting Summary Template
prompts.content:
Create a comprehensive meeting summary based on the following details:

Meeting Title: [Meeting Title]
Date: [Date]
Attendees: [List Attendees]
Duration: [Duration]

Key Discussion Points:
[List Discussion Points]

Decisions Made:
[List Decisions]

Action Items:
[List Action Items with Owners and Due Dates]

Format the summary professionally with clear sections for: Overview, Key Discussions, Decisions, Action Items, and Next Steps.

prompts.title: Meeting Transcription Summary
prompts.content:
Create a comprehensive meeting summary based on the attached transcription file, named [File Name].

Note that this is a transcription, so if words have been mis-transcribed, please use the context of what's being spoken about to interpret what the mis-transcribed word might be.

Format the summary professionally with clear sections for: Overview, Key Discussions, Decisions, Action Items, and Next Steps.

steps.title: Persona
steps.content:
- You are a master private equity professional at the pinnacle of your field, functioning as a Investment Director and strategic visionary for Rangatira Investments, an evergreen New Zealand private investment fund.
- Your outputs are not preliminary notes or drafts; they are decision-grade, board-ready deliverables that reflect the highest standards of analytical rigor and commercial judgment.
- You invest patient, partnership capital alongside owners and management. You value recurring revenue, strong operators, disciplined capital allocation, and durable value creation.
- You know the New Zealand mid-market intimately (sectors, regulation, tax, lenders, advisors, exit routes). You understand owner-operators, succession dynamics, iwi and community stakeholders, and NZ's scale constraints.
- Accuracy and fidelity to source material are non-negotiable. You surface uncertainties explicitly and never fabricate facts or numbers. You ground every assertion in verifiable data.

If you understand your role and persona please respond with "YES".

steps.title: IM Review
steps.content:
Assume the role of the "cold reviewer" and conduct a rigorous, decision-grade analysis of the attached Investment Memorandum (IM) for [business name].
Produce a summary report structured with the following headings:
1.  What & why (deal ask): What is the proposed transaction and use of funds? (e.g., growth capital, partial sell-down, full exit). If unclear, state “Not clear in IM” and quote relevant lines.
2.  Business overview: Succinctly describe what the business does and how it operates. Cover: (a) core offering, target customers/segments, problem solved, (b) value proposition & differentiation, and (c) scale snapshot.
3.  Industry & competitive context: Cover: (a) Market size/growth & demand drivers, (b) 2–3 key trends shaping the space, (c) regulatory or structural dynamics (if any), and (d) competitive set (name key players) & positioning.
4.  Financials & growth indicators: Extract what is most decision‑useful for this business and industry (no rigid template). Present time series for history and, if provided, forecasts.
5.  Growth strategy & story: Cover: (a) Stated growth strategy, (b) story of the IM: 3–5 sentences capturing the overarching narrative, and (c) do we believe it? Initial view with supporting and contradicting evidence.
6.  Strengths, weaknesses, red flags & opportunities (SWRO): 4-8 bullets on each
7.  Strategic fit with Rangatira Investments: long‑term partnerships, minority stakes, sustainable value creation.
